observation.command:
cd /workspace/src/Bovis.Web && COOKIE=UIH234dcbjn0934723dwmZSIZL2342423KUOWidsqw6123e
echo "### Decisive: 12 consecutive /app requests WITH appsettings admin cookie"
for i in $(seq 1 12); do
  BODY=$(curl -s --max-time 8 -H "Cookie: bovis_auth_cookie=$COOKIE" "http://localhost:5195/app")
  if echo "$BODY" | grep -q "Bovis Bohrsäulenvisualisierung"; then r=ADMIN; else r=noadmin; fi
  printf "%s " "$r"
done; echo
echo "### What password hashes to sha1:9016629f058f6179fdac76f3f797ae776811ad05 (documented user 'user')?"
for pw in user password admin bovis secret letmein 1234; do
  h=$(printf '%s' "$pw" | sha1sum | awk '{print toupper($1)}')
  echo "$pw -> $h"
done
